title: How to lead with a human-centered approach in a changing media industry
summary: The media industry is defined by constant transformation. Many organizations are racing to meet cost pressures, improve efficiency and maintain stability within their teams. Broadcast technology, for example, has shifted rapidly in recent years as traditional serial digital interface (SDI) environments give way to IP-based infrastructure and software-driven workflows. And, of course, AI is accelerating change across every corner of the media industry.
